Project.name: Meetings & Collaboration
Project.description: Syncs, planning, retros, pair programming, team chats. Tools e.g. Zoom, Slack, Notion. Sites e.g. zoom.us, notion.so, slack.com. Meetings e.g. standup, sprint retro, pair session. Keywords e.g. agenda, minutes, sync, review.

Project.name: Feature Development
Project.description: Coding new features, bug fixes, sprint tasks. Tools e.g. IDEs (VS Code), terminals. Sites e.g. github.com, nango.dev. Meetings e.g. standups, sprint planning. Keywords e.g. commit, PR, deploy, ticket, backlog.

Project.name: Internal Tools & Automation
Project.description: Building or maintaining scripts, integrations, productivity tools. Tools e.g. CLI, automation (Zapier). Sites e.g. zapier.com, script editors. Keywords e.g. script, automation, build, CLI, workflow.

Project.name: DevOps & Infrastructure
Project.description: Deployment, infra updates, monitoring, incident response. Tools e.g. cloud dashboards (AWS), monitoring (Datadog). Sites e.g. console.aws.amazon.com, datadoghq.com. Keywords e.g. deploy, infra, pipeline, incident, alert.

Project.name: Code Review & Testing
Project.description: Reviewing PRs, writing and running tests, QA. Tools e.g. GitHub, CI tools (GitHub Actions). Sites e.g. github.com, circleci.com. Keywords e.g. review, CI, test, merge, approval, coverage.
